reply.text:
This sounds like a medical symptom, so I'm not going to assess it. Spots in your vision, blurring and a pounding head are things to get checked by a doctor now, not later. If the symptoms are severe, sudden, or don't settle quickly, please get emergency medical care right away or call your local emergency number.

Stop training for today. Once a doctor or physio has cleared you, tell me what they said and I'll build the training around whatever they clear. I'm glad to keep going on the training side with you after that.
